output.reason: PMK 168/2023 replaces PMK 252/PMK.03/2008 and PMK 250/PMK.03/2008 and changes how PPh 21 is computed for permanent employees (Pegawai Tetap) from 1 January 2024. In every tax period other than the last, the monthly effective rate (TER) is applied to monthly gross income. In the last tax period, annual tax under the Article 17 rates is reconciled against the tax already withheld. The regulation also defines gross income for permanent employees, including employer-paid JKK, JKM and health insurance contributions. It sets the allowable deductions: biaya jabatan at 5% capped at Rp6,000,000 per year or Rp500,000 per month, pension/JHT contributions, and zakat. It further covers the PTKP rules, rounding of taxable income down to full thousands, annualisation for partial years, and the refund of over-withholding.
